<observations>
Date: May 4, 2026
* 🔴 Kitchen remodel project started: Modern island with integrated sink, $515 quiet disposal sink, matte black faucet ('Eclipse'), contractor quote $21,250 (revised May 7). Pet: dog Bella. Fixture deadline May 10.

Date: May 7, 2026
* 🔴 Brushed nickel hardware, dimmable RGB lighting kit ($275), waterfall quartz countertop ($4,200 estimate), herringbone subway tile ($1,150). Pet: cat Whiskers. Backsplash deadline May 12.

Date: May 10, 2026
* 🔴 Pull-out pantry requested, ColorWave "Arctic Fog" low-VOC paint ($45/gal), FaucetWorks pot-filler ($420), ChillBox under-counter fridge ($1,120), GreenThumb self-watering herb kit ($85). Appliance deadline May 18.

Date: May 13, 2026
* 🔴 Calacatta Gold quartz island slab ($4,750), brushed nickel cabinet handles ($12/ea), VinoVault compact wine cooler ($920), BrightBeam LED strip ($68). Pet: cat Luna (safe zone kit $85). Rule: Always send photos before opening walls. Lighting milestone deadline May 16.

Date: May 17, 2026
* 🔴 Oakridge 'LunaSeries' matte white cabinets ordered ($1,850/ea, delivery June 5), TileWorld Arctic Pearl glass tile, built-in coffee station added, plumbing permit PR-2026-517 obtained.
* 🟡 Demolition rescheduled to May 27 at 8 AM (user out of town May 24–26). CityPower electrical inspection May 20 at 2 PM.
* ✅ Agent uploaded revised 3-D kitchen model showing cabinets, backsplash, coffee station, and faucet.

Date: May 21, 2026
* 🔴 StoneCraft "RiverEdge" light gray quartz countertops ordered ($3,200/slab, 3 slabs, delivery June 8), LuminaLighting "Nimbus" pendant lights ($89/ea), ChillBox C12 12-bottle wine cooler, EcoTemp Pro smart thermostat (install June 15). Appliance allowance: $6,300.
* 🟡 WaterWorks plumbing rough-in inspection booked for May 28 at 10 AM. Nimbus pendants configured with Zig-Bee dimmer for June 20 dinner party.
* ✅ Agent uploaded revised floor plan showing countertop, island wine cooler, and lighting scheme; sent summary email with milestones (countertop June 8, lighting June 13, thermostat June 15).
</observations>

<current-task>
- Primary: Kitchen remodel tracking and milestone management.
- Upcoming Milestones: Countertop delivery June 8, lighting installation June 13, thermostat setup June 15.
</current-task>

<suggested-response>
"I've updated the kitchen plan with the latest selections and milestones. Let me know if you'd like to review anything further before the upcoming delivery and inspection dates."
</suggested-response>
